verdict.line: You win if you land E (Death's Grasp) into R (Realm of Death) while his W (Remove Scurvy) is down, roughly levels 4-11; you lose if you let Grog-Soaked Blade poison and Parrrley poke chip you down over a lane that only nets Mordekaiser 48.7% across 261 games.

brief.thesis: This matchup is decided by cooldown math between your E (Death's Grasp) engage and his W (Remove Scurvy) cleanse: pull him in while his cleanse is down and you get a full Q (Obliterate) + R (Realm of Death) all-in, but if his W is up he cleanses the pull, heals off it, and resets the fight. Gangplank's Grog-Soaked Blade poison and Parrrley poke chip you down across the laning phase regardless, which is why Mordekaiser's raw solo-kill tools still only convert to 48.7% over a real sample.

theirWindow.what: He can cleanse your E (Death's Grasp) pull and heal off the stored damage, so don't commit the all-in — poke with Q (Obliterate) at range and wait him out instead.

yourWindow.when: His W (Remove Scurvy) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land E (Death's Grasp) to pull him into Q (Obliterate) range, then follow with R (Realm of Death) once you're level 6+ — the pull holds and there is no cleanse to break it.

start.why: Highest-performing start for this matchup at 53.8% over 171 games — the extra sustain and mana offset Grog-Soaked Blade poison and let you hold Q (Obliterate) trades without backing off early.

boots.why: Picked in 85.9% of games at 50.9% win rate — his damage is steady autos and poison, not hard CC, so flat damage reduction outperforms tenacity here.

core.why: The slow from Q/E lets you stick to him through his poke phase instead of letting him kite with Parrrley.

runes.keystoneWhy: This page's 69% win rate is the best-performing option in the data — the adaptive force stacking rewards the extended, repeated trades this lane forces through his poison and your sustain items.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo at 74.7% pick rate — Ignite converts your R (Realm of Death) all-in into a guaranteed kill once he's pulled in and low, matching the aggressive, solo-kill-favored shape of this matchup.

playing.title: Farm Through His Poke
playing.detail: Don't trade autos just to trade — focus farming and only commit when you can land E (Death's Grasp), since that's how you convert stat advantages into kills instead of bleeding to poison for free.

playing.title: Track His Remove Scurvy
playing.detail: Before going E (Death's Grasp) into R (Realm of Death), check whether his W (Remove Scurvy, 22-18s cooldown by rank) is up — if it is, he cleanses the pull and heals, so hold the all-in.

playing.title: All-In at Level Six
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) unlocks a stat-steal execute threat at level 6; land E into R while his W is down to guarantee the fight stays locked in your range.

playing.title: Front-Load Your Aggression
playing.detail: Grog-Soaked Blade's poison scales with his level, so auto-for-auto trades get worse for you as the game goes — win your fights in the early-mid levels, not late skirmishes.

playing.title: Hold Shield for Trades
playing.detail: Let W (Indestructible) store damage from his poke before consuming it to heal — popping it early for a small heal wastes the absorption you need during his poison phase.

playing.title: Steelcaps Over Tenacity
playing.detail: His kit here has no hard CC to dodge, just sustained poison and autos — Plated Steelcaps' flat reduction beats Mercury's Treads at 85.9% pick rate for a reason.

playing.title: Scale Past His Mid-Game Spike
playing.detail: Once Rylai's into Riftmaker comes online, your sustained damage and slow start winning extended trades again — survive his levels 7-11 poison spike rather than forcing fights into it.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, boots, and summoner spells above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the cooldown-window reasoning, trade timing, and lane-state calls are my own tactical read layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being punished by Gangplank’s (E). Focus on farming lane while engaging combat whenever he steps in range of [E].
